corpus: 200 WA legislation documents seeded from the Open Australian Legal Corpus, plus the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) compilation 73 (4 volumes) and the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth), both ingested from the Federal Register.
note: Queries are paraphrases, not verbatim provision text, so the test is not trivially lexical. Targets are identified by citation and section, not by database id, so the set survives a reseed. The absent set must be re-checked whenever the corpus grows: two Fair Work queries were retired from it once the Act was ingested, because they stopped being absent. Section identifiers here are pinpoints, not row ids, so a labelling fix changes them: 'Casual employees of small business employers' was recorded as s 47A while Schedule 1's clauses carried plain numbers, and is 'Sch 1 cl 47A' now that they are labelled. Re-run this set after ANY splitter change, not only after a corpus change - a relabelled provision fails here silently and looks like a retrieval regression.
